FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 491
Committee: Health Sponsor: Representative Reed Ingram
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 04/22/2025
House Bill 491 as introduced could increase or decrease the obligations of the local boards of
education by an undetermined amount dependent on the difference the costs of food options that
would meet the requirements of this bill and the cost of food otherwise provided absent this bill.
